Hi Lara —

Thanks — and congrats on the onboarding lift. I pulled together an initial health snapshot and a few concrete options. High-level:
- Token/Request growth: +180% month-over-month for active endpoints; embeddings disproportionately higher (~220%)
- Latency: p50 steady at 70ms on the current model; p95 has increased from 320ms -> 480ms during peak 11a–1p PT windows
- Cost: unit cost per 1k tokens increased ~12% due to peak batching inefficiency; we can reduce that with a small configuration + dedicated capacity.

Attached is a CSV with the token breakdown and a short one-pager with three term options (conservative renewal, committed uplift, and dedicated pilot). Best,

Kim / Lara —

Quick internal note and recommendation for the thread: given the 2.8x sustained uplift, we should present a middle-ground committed uplift offer that:
1) Adds a dedicated capacity tranche sized for 1.6x current sustained baseline (smoothing peak spikes)
2) Includes a 3-month burst buffer and a 10% discount tier for token thresholds > 50M/month

I can sketch the pricing numbers by EOD Thursday. Also recommend we propose a 12-month term with an optional 6-month extension tied to usage thresholds — that gives ScaleForm budget predictability and us runway to prove ROI.
